summary: Notes from the Network Working Group meeting held May 16 to 19, 1971. They are meant as reference for attendees rather than a complete readable account, ordered chronologically, with later dates taking precedence over earlier plans.

eli5.summary: The scribbled notes from a big meeting. They help those who were there remember what was said, but may not make sense to others.
